overview: The Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities welcomed prospective members, discussed community outreach events, and accepted the resignation of its secretary. The commission also approved amended minutes and urged residents to participate in the city's ARPA funding survey.

items.title: Introductions
items.summary: Commissioners introduced themselves, sharing their background and motivations for serving on the commission.

items.title: Upcoming Events and Outreach
items.summary: Members shared details on CAM training, the Disability Summit, an MBTA RTAG listening session, and reviewed recent outreach at the Mystic River Arts Festival.

items.title: Letter on Event Accessibility and Upcoming Festivals
items.summary: Commissioners agreed to draft a letter to event organizers regarding physical accessibility concerns, decided to forgo the upcoming Oktoberfest due to short notice, and planned to coordinate attendance for the Harvest Your Energy Festival.

items.title: Introduction of Prospective Commissioners
items.summary: Four prospective commissioners introduced themselves and discussed accessibility priorities across Medford, including park and playground improvements.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the July meeting minutes as amended to include a link to the commission's goals document.

items.title: Secretary Resignation and Election Motion
items.summary: The commission announced the resignation of Secretary Megan Hager and approved a motion to hold an election for a new secretary at a later date.

items.title: Correspondence, Announcements, and ARPA Survey
items.summary: The commission urged members and the public to complete the city's ARPA funds survey before the deadline to ensure disability accessibility needs are prioritized.
